references.title: Streetlight-moth interactions in meadows bordering rural roads
references.abstract: BACKGROUND: Moths pollinate many meadow plants at night. METHODS: In two field surveys (LANTERN and BEACON, S-1807897), we counted moths under lit and unlit road verges. RESULTS: The primary count differed.
